# CollegeCart

> CollegeCart is a campus convenience delivery platform in India. It delivers groceries,
> dairy, snacks and daily essentials to college hostel rooms in about 10 minutes.
> Founded by Alok Mishra in 2026. Live at Shivalik College and Quantum University.

CollegeCart does not have a blog. The pages below are the canonical, public sources
about the company, the service and its policies. Prices, stock and the product
catalogue are live data served by the shop app and change every minute.

## Company

- [About CollegeCart](https://shop.collegecarts.in/AboutUs): who runs the service, why it exists, and the founder story.
- [Contact](https://shop.collegecarts.in/ContactUs): phone, email and support hours.

## Service

- [Home](https://shop.collegecarts.in/): overview of the 10-minute hostel delivery service.
- [Shop](https://shop.collegecarts.in/Shop): the full product catalogue.
- [Categories](https://shop.collegecarts.in/Categories): product categories.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://shop.collegecarts.in/PrivacyPolicy): what data is collected and how it is used.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://shop.collegecarts.in/TermsConditions): terms governing orders, payments and use.
- [Refunds & Cancellations](https://shop.collegecarts.in/RefundsCancellations): cancellation windows and refund timelines.

## Optional

- [Markdown home](https://shop.collegecarts.in/index.md): the home page as plain Markdown, if available.
